rows.Product Name: Magenta Gota Braid with Pearl Rows

rows.Description: A light-wash denim playsuit cut like a shirt jacket on top — point collar, button-through placket, flap chest pockets — then released into a frayed-hem short below. Open cut-outs at either side of the waist keep it from reading as workwear. Rolled cuffs, deep slant pockets, and a raw edge that softens with every wash.

Ivory cotton cut high on the waist and worked all over in black thread — diamond medallions down each leg, a scalloped border tracing the hem and both pocket mouths. Structured enough to hold its shape, light enough for the heat. Button-and-zip fly with deep slant pockets.
